description: The image displays three side-by-side pie charts representing the distribution of various logical and linguistic categories. The first chart on the left, titled "Categorical," contains four slices: Universal Quantifiers in light blue (29.07%), Limiter in light pink (27.91%), Negation in light orange (27.91%), and Existential Quantifiers in light green (15.12%). The middle chart, which has a blurred title, consists of three slices arranged counter-clockwise in descending order of size: Approximate Quantities in light beige (45.03%), Comparative Relationships in light blue (36.26%), and Absolute Absence in light purple (18.71%). The third chart on the right, titled "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: Conjunctive in light pink (50.49%) and Disjunctive in light grey-blue (49.51%). None of the charts include an external legend; instead, all category labels and their corresponding exact percentages are printed directly inside the slices in bold text. There are no exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized segments in any of the three charts.
